items.title: 68429_Walter P. Thomas oral history interview
items.q: and we was like an idol of his, because we knew him when he was...

ctx.x: What would we have to play for them, Foots?
'Sweet Georgia Brown.' And he'd get on the floor and do his dance to "Sweet Georgia Brown," and we was like an idol of his, because we knew him when he was... See, George Raft was never a gangster.
